readingUncertainties: The two 21SEP duties overlap as printed: block A reports 22:45 on 21SEP and ends 08:30 on 22SEP, block B reports 18:30 on 21SEP and ends 03:53 on 22SEP. Both cannot be flown by one crew member. I have transcribed them exactly as printed rather than re-dating either one, because every alternative date (20SEP, 22SEP) is already occupied by another duty or leaves an illegal rest. This may be an error in the source roster.
The STBY time being the end rather than the start of the window is an inference from the column it sits in plus rest-legality; the roster never states it explicitly.
